title: pilosella koernickeana
intro: Pilosella koernickeana, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe, is a type of rare, perennial herb native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella koernickeana are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
